listing.name: AI Mini-Battles
listing.summary: This is the tournament mod used for the 0.97a Brawl King tournament, updated to 0.98a with a few new features to enable tournament hosting for this version, at least until the actual AI Battles mod gets updated.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a tournament mode for hosting AI battles with support for officers, fleet skills, and automated ship CR limits.

description: Provides a tournament framework originally used for the 0.97a Brawl King tournament, now updated for version 0.98a. It includes features to enable tournament hosting, such as support for officers, fleet skills, and Automated Ship CR limits.
descriptionHtml: Provides a tournament framework originally used for the 0.97a Brawl King tournament, now updated for version 0.98a. It includes features to enable tournament hosting, such as support for officers, fleet skills, and Automated Ship CR limits.
discordPostHtml:
This is the tournament mod used for the 0.97a Brawl King tournament, updated to 0.98a with a few new features to enable tournament hosting for this version, at least until the actual AI Battles mod gets updated.

Has support for officers, fleet skills, Automated Ship CR limits, etc.

(No long-term support or forum post at this time because I do not feel like maintaining yet another mod lol.)
